 Search Mark McGuinn dies at 58
 Buddy Iahn 
 November 11, 2026 
 Country 
 The Music Universe McGuinn is best known for “Mrs. Steven Rudy”
 Country artist and songwriter Mark McGuinn has died at 58. The announcement was made last week by his niece, Jamie Lynn, who revealed the news on social media .
 “My Uncle Mark passed away at the end of October. His memorial service is tomorrow. I will miss his sense of humor and hugs. Luckily, I can still hear his voice. Been listening to his music on repeat these last couple of weeks,” she says.
 McGuinn was a Greensboro, North Carolina native who made country music history with his 2001 debut single, “Mrs. Steven Rudy,” released via VFR Records. The track became the first Top 10 country hit by a new independent-label artist in more than four decades. His self-titled debut album also broke independent-label records, proving that outsiders could reach mainstream country radio. With his distinctive voice and genre-bending style, McGuinn challenged country music conventions and helped clear a path for the independent artists who followed.
 In place of flowers, the family invites memorial donations to the MusiCares Foundation—which provides vital health and human services to music professionals in need—or to Christ United Methodist Church, 410 N. Holden Rd., Greensboro, NC.
 No cause of death was revealed.
